itemJob.description: Set ONLY when the user asked for the same work to be done to every item in one folder or in the Finder selection — "summarise each of these", "convert all of these folders". Null for every other command, including one that names two or three things explicitly, which is an ordinary multi-step plan. When set, steps describes the work done to ONE item and Sonny repeats it for each item it finds.

fileExtensions.description: File extensions without dots, such as pdf or docx, when the user named a kind of file. Null for every file, and null whenever itemKind is folders.

folderPath.description: The folder to read when source is folder, otherwise null.

itemField.description: Which field of each repeated step the item is written into: inputPath for a capability that reads a file or folder, shortcutInput for running a Shortcut on each item. Required when source is set; null otherwise.

itemKind.description: Whether each item is a file or a folder. Required when source is set; null otherwise.

source.description: Where the items come from: folder for a folder the user named, finder_selection for whatever they have selected in Finder. NULL when this is not a job over many items, which is almost every command.

requiresConfirmation.description: True when the action writes files, opens apps, or converts documents.

appName.description: Human app name for open_app or switch_running_app actions, or null.

browserName.description: The browser the user named for a URL-opening step, exactly as they said it (for example "Chrome", "Safari"), or null when they named none.

contextSource.description: Use finder_selection when the user refers to selected Finder items, or null.

count.description: Requested count, such as top 3 files or top 5 headlines.

draftContent.description: User-provided body content for create_local_draft Markdown drafts, the expansion text for save_snippet, or null.

draftTitle.description: Title for create_local_draft Markdown drafts, or null.
